questions.stem: Why does heart rate increase during exercise?

options.text: To increase the amount of glucose stored in the heart
To slow down the rate of respiration
To remove lactic acid from the lungs
To pump more blood carrying oxygen and glucose to the muscles

questions.explanation: During exercise, muscles need more energy. The heart beats faster to deliver more oxygenated blood and glucose to active muscles, and to remove waste products like carbon dioxide more quickly.
